sources.name: National Planning Policy Framework
sources.verified_fact: Current GOV.UK framework page identifies the new NPPF version published 12 December 2024 and lists policy sections including plan-making, decision-making, housing, land use, design, Green Belt, climate, natural and historic environment.

sources.name: Green Belt guidance
sources.verified_fact: Guidance last updated 27 February 2025 covers grey-belt assessment, remaining Green Belt impact, proposals, sustainable locations, Golden Rules, accessible green space and openness.

sources.name: Community Infrastructure Levy guidance
sources.verified_fact: Guidance last updated 17 June 2026 covers charging schedules/rates, reliefs/exemptions, liability calculation, collection, spending, appeals, developer contributions and monitoring/reporting.

sources.name: Planning obligations guidance
sources.verified_fact: Planning obligations are legally binding and run with land; the statutory/policy tests require necessity, direct relation to development and fair/reasonable scale and kind.

sources.name: Planning obligations good practice
sources.verified_fact: Good-practice advice last updated 5 February 2025 covers justification, form, parties, content, unilateral undertakings, modification/discharge, affordable housing and pooled contributions/tariffs.

sources.name: How to create a neighbourhood plan
sources.verified_fact: Published 31 March 2026; covers establishment, evidence base, engagement, drafting, basic conditions, pre-submission consultation, submission, examination, referendum and adoption.

sources.name: Neighbourhood planning toolkits
sources.verified_fact: Collection contains 2026 toolkits and explicitly states the toolkits are being updated to reflect recent planning-policy changes, expected by April 2027.

sources.name: Brownfield land registers data standard
sources.verified_fact: National brownfield-register data standard last updated 17 October 2025; update added the unknown-ownership instruction.

sources.name: Permission in principle
sources.verified_fact: PiP separates in-principle matters from technical details; scope is location, land use and amount of development, with remaining matters for technical-details consent.

sources.name: Planning appeals procedural guide post-1-Apr-2026
sources.verified_fact: Guide published 12 February 2026 and last updated 16 July 2026; applies to applications submitted on or after 1 April 2026.

sources.name: Planning appeals procedural guide pre-1-Apr-2026
sources.verified_fact: Guide last updated 16 July 2026 applies to appeals relating to applications dated on or before 31 March 2026.

sources.name: CIL Regulation 117/118/119 decisions
sources.verified_fact: Decision page last updated 16 July 2026 and lists current CIL notice appeal decisions/routes.

guards: Strategic/general guidance is not promoted to parcel-specific permission, capacity, charge or obligation.
Brownfield Part 1 suitability is not treated as full planning permission.
PiP is not treated as technical-details consent.
Appeal procedural route is selected from application date and is not itself an appeal outcome.
Older-but-current official guidance is retained with lower confidence than freshly updated 2026 guidance.
No candidate promotion without exact site/parcel/project evidence.
